defs.def: a white substance that is added to food to give it a better flavour or to preserve it. Salt is obtained from mines and is also found in sea water. It is sometimes called common salt to distinguish it from other chemical salts. 盐；食盐

ex.s: Many people suspect that all the rock salt used every winter is harming the environment.
ex.t: 许多人怀疑每年使用的所有岩盐都在损害环境。

ex.s: There has been a recent trend in the food service industry toward lower fat content and less salt.
ex.t: 近来食品服务业出现了降低脂肪含量和减少盐用量的趋势。

ex.s: 67   (be) full of fat and salt; by   68   (eat) more fast food people will get more salt and fat than they need in their diet.
ex.t: 67   （充满）脂肪和盐；通过   68   （吃）更多快餐，人们会摄入超过饮食所需的盐和脂肪。

ex.s: And as salt and pepper would simply float away, astronauts are provided with these in liquid form.
ex.t: 因为盐和胡椒会直接飘走，宇航员被提供的是液态形式的这些调料。

ex.s: Processed foods often contain less nutrition, and have higher quantities of sugar, salt, and fat than fresh ingredients.
ex.t: 加工食品通常含有较少的营养，并且比新鲜食材含有更高量的糖、盐和脂肪。

ex.s: INGREDIENTS 4 egg whites a little salt 1 cup sugar 2 teaspoons flour 2/3 teaspoon vinegar 2/3 teaspoon vanilla 2 cups cream fresh fruit 2 Read the text again and answer the questions.
ex.t: 配料：4个蛋清、少许盐、1杯糖、2茶匙面粉、2/3茶匙醋、2/3茶匙香草精、2杯奶油、新鲜水果。再读一遍文本，回答问题。

ex.s: I had almost no strength left; my fingers could hardly move; my mouth, opening and closing, filled with salt water.
ex.t: 我几乎没有力气了；我的手指几乎不能动；我的嘴，开和闭，充满了盐水。

ex.s: Each Nanjing salted duck takes several days to prepare, and the process includes salting, drying, boiling and cooling.
ex.t: 每只南京盐鸭需数日准备，工艺包括盐，干,沸和冷。

ex.s: Normally, towns use rock salt to de-ice streets.
ex.t: 通常，城镇使用岩盐来为街道除冰。

ex.s: But using cheese brine could help both cheese producers and cities save money, while keeping roads safe Cheese brine has salt in it, which, like the rock salt, helps lower water’s freezing point.
ex.t: 但使用奶酪盐水可以帮助奶酪生产者和城市省钱，同时保持道路安全。奶酪盐水里含有盐，与岩盐一样，有助于降低水的冰点。

ex.s: It may seem like a simple request to ask for salt and pepper at a meal
ex.t: 用餐时要求加盐和胡椒粉似乎是个简单的请求。

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.
ex.t: 通过在添加一层岩盐之前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能能将其岩盐使用量减少30%。

defs.def: a chemical formed from a metal and an acid 盐（金属和酸组成的化学物质）

ex.s: Fat and salt are very important parts of a diet.
ex.t: 脂肪和盐是饮食中非常重要的组成部分。

defs.def: a substance that looks or tastes like salt 形状（或味道）像盐的物质
to put salt on or in food 在（食物）中放盐

ex.s: When fat and salt     64     (remove) from food, the food tastes as if is missing something.
ex.t: 当脂肪和盐从食物中   64   （去除），食物尝起来像少了什么。

ex.s: But while you probably add only a small amount of salt to your food, road crews spread about 20 million tons of salt on U.
ex.t: 但尽管你大概只在食物中加少量盐，道路养护工在美国的道路上撒下约2000万吨盐。

defs.def: to preserve food with salt 用盐腌制（食物）
to put salt on roads to melt ice or snow 把盐撒在路面上（以使冰雪融化）
